steps.eval: (()=>{const F=s=>s.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/œ/g,'oe');const s=T.view().state;const m=s.selection.main;const l=s.doc.lineAt(m.from);return JSON.stringify({doc:rocksy.activeDoc().name, line0:l.number-1, col:m.from-l.from, selected:s.sliceDoc(m.from,m.to), selectedIsTerm:F(s.sliceDoc(m.from,m.to)).startsWith('plan'), termMarks:T.count('.cm-term-hl'), flash:T.count('.cm-lp-flash')})})()

(()=>{const a=rocksy.sidebar.search.samples;const stt=(k)=>{const s=a.map(x=>x[k]).sort((x,y)=>x-y);const q=p=>s[Math.min(s.length-1,Math.floor(p*s.length))];return {median:q(.5),p95:q(.95),max:q(1)}};return JSON.stringify({searches:a.length, keystrokeToPainted:stt('total'), callRoundTrip:stt('call'), backendMs:stt('backend'), uiOverhead:(()=>{const s=a.map(x=>x.total-x.call-80).sort((x,y)=>x-y);return {median:+s[Math.floor(s.length/2)].toFixed(1), p95:+s[Math.floor(s.length*.95)].toFixed(1)}})(), filesMax:Math.max(...a.map(x=>x.files))})})()

(async()=>{const F=s=>s.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/œ/g,'oe');const out=[];let seed=11;const rnd=()=>{seed=(seed*1103515245+12345)&0x7fffffff;return seed/0x7fffffff};const cache={};for(const [q,term] of [['plan','plan'],['budget','budget'],['strategie','strategie'],['reunion audit','reunion|audit'],['"plan decision"','plan decision'],['archi','archi'],['kolueux','kolueux'],['tag:projet risque','risque'],['path:meetings client','client'],['equipe','equipe']]){const r=await T.inv('search',{query:q,limit:50});if(!r.hits.length){out.push({q,total:r.total,none:true});continue}const withM=r.hits.filter(h=>h.matches.length);if(!withM.length){out.push({q,total:r.total,noBodyMatch:true});continue}const h=withM[Math.floor(rnd()*withM.length)];const m=h.matches[Math.floor(rnd()*h.matches.length)];const text=cache[h.path]||(cache[h.path]=(await T.inv('read_file',{path:h.path})).text);const L=text.split(/\r\n|\n/);const at=(L[m.line]||'').substr(m.col,m.len);const ex=m.ranges.map(([a,b])=>m.excerpt.slice(a,b));out.push({q,total:r.total,ms:r.ms,file:h.path.split('\\').pop(),line:m.line,col:m.col,len:m.len,atPos:at,ok:new RegExp('^('+term+')').test(F(at)),excerptMarks:ex.slice(0,3),marksOk:ex.every(x=>new RegExp('^('+term.replace(' ','|')+')').test(F(x))),nameMatch:h.nameMatch,matchCount:h.matchCount})}return JSON.stringify(out)})()

(async()=>{const sp=rocksy.sidebar.search;const out={};const qs=['"','-','tag:','path:','"non fermé','-mot','(a+b)*[c]?^$.\\\\|','😀 plan','plan 😀','   ','x'.repeat(500),'tag:#','""','path:\\\\ plan','*','a'];for(const q of qs){sp.input.value=q;let err=null;const t=performance.now();try{await sp.run()}catch(e){err=String(e)}let direct=null;try{const r=await T.inv('search',{query:q});direct={total:r.total,ready:r.searchReady}}catch(e){direct={rejected:JSON.stringify(e)}}out[q.slice(0,24)]={ms:Math.round(performance.now()-t),err,direct,info:document.querySelector('.search-info').textContent,msg:(document.querySelector('.search-msg')||{}).textContent||null}}sp.clear();return JSON.stringify(out)})()

(async()=>{const lp=rocksy.sidebar.links;const ts=[];for(let i=0;i<5;i++){const t=performance.now();await lp.refresh();void lp.body.offsetHeight;ts.push(+(performance.now()-t).toFixed(1))}const t1=performance.now();await T.inv('outgoing_links',{path:rocksy.activeDoc().path});const ipc=performance.now()-t1;return JSON.stringify({refreshMs:ts, outgoingIpcMs:+ipc.toFixed(1), back:rocksy.metrics.backlinks, out:rocksy.metrics.outgoing, unresolvedShown:T.count('.lk-out.is-missing'), domNodes:document.querySelectorAll('.links-content *').length, sections:[...document.querySelectorAll('.links-sec')].map(e=>e.textContent)})})()
